asr.full_text: There is some new movement in the Gowda Party... The Karnataka Constitutional Commission faced a very embarrassing picture today Congress members went on a rampage over the rule of the president Some C-M-L-C members of Congress sat on the chair of the Deputy Chairman And after that, everything that was done was very embarrassing Congress Constitutional Commission members misbehaved with the Deputy Chairman Dharmingora They pressured him out of his chair They came out by pushing him away This commotion was going on for a long time The report is shown. This is the constitution of the constitution. The temple of democracy where the most important people of the society are regulated so that the dignity and tradition of democracy can be taken care of, its implementation can be done properly. But today in the Karnataka constitution, whatever happened, it has affected the limits of democracy. The problem was that the ruling BJP had to bring a no confidence motion against the chairman of the council. BJP was accused of not having numbers with the chairman of the council. That's why he can't chair this seat. This special seat was called on the governor's order, this special article was called today. After removing the chairman of the council from his post, BJP had to pass the murderous law bill. But nothing happened. Before the chair of the council's chairman sat on the chair, the deputy chairman was made to sit on the chair and Congress took its objection and the deputy chairman was manhandled and pulled out of the chair by the deputy chairman and the chair was pushed. When the chairman reached the chair, the BJP and the JDS members stopped him. But as the BJP and JDS were suspicious, the chairman reached to the chair with the help of the marshals and this seat was signed. They have passed this new motion of no confidence Now they will have to leave this position of chairman That is why under a conspiracy it has been signed Now BJP has reached governor His speech in this Gohar is against the rules of the country And all people should be subjected to a penal action With Kamerman Kiran Siti.Raghavan, India TV, Bengaluru. Due to the shameless acts of Congress, the work of the president has been postponed for indefinite time. Actually, five days ago, the Gaurakshah law was passed in the Karnataka Assembly. Congress opposed this bill and today, a special session was called in the Assembly. In which the Gaurakshah law was to be presented. They have started doing it here in Arunachal and in all parts of Goa. So he is saying that Chairman did not have the moral right to sit on chair? We'll not talk about ethics and moral right, the Government is illegitimate. They have brought in 17 citizens to make this government, that is not legal or illegal. If someone's hands have powers, then this happens. That's the reason why we can't have power... They want to run the house that has been sanitized. Who does it work for? Does it work for BJP? Is it the BJP government? Are there BJP ministers? Are there BJP prime ministers? How do they want to run it? We don't understand. Let's pause here for a short break and watch India TV's satire show, Fakir-e-Aasim.
